title: Kitchen safety
examples: What is the safest thing to do with sharp knives?
How can I stop germs from spreading in the kitchen?
Why do we need to wash our hands before cooking?

explain.say: Today we are learning about keeping our kitchen safe.

items: Keep raw meat away from other food.

explain.say: When using knives, always ask an adult for help.
Be careful around heat sources like stoves and ovens.
Always wash your hands with soap and running water.
Keep raw meat separate from ready-to-eat foods.
In real life, always use separate cutting boards for raw meat.

faq.q: Why must I wash my hands before cooking?
faq.a: You wash your hands to remove germs you picked up from surfaces or touching pets. You can also say this to remove germs from playing outside. Another way to ask is, 'Should I clean my hands first?'
asks: Why do I need to wash my hands?
What should I do before I cook?

faq.a: It means germs moving from one food to another, like from raw meat to salad. You can also ask, 'How do germs jump from food to food?' or 'What is germ transfer?'
asks: How do I stop germs from moving?
Is it bad if raw meat touches lettuce?

faq.q: Can I use the same knife for everything?
faq.a: No, you should use different tools or wash them very well in between. You might also ask, 'Do I need different knives?' or 'Can I reuse my cutting board?'
asks: Is it okay to cut meat and then bread on the same board?

faq.q: How do I handle hot pots safely?
faq.a: Always ask an adult to help you with anything hot. You should never touch hot surfaces without help. Another way to ask is, 'Who should touch the hot pan?'
asks: Is it safe for me to move the hot pot?
What if I touch the steam?

faq.q: Where should I put raw chicken?
faq.a: You should put raw chicken on a plate or board away from other food. You can also ask, 'What surface is best for raw meat?'
asks: Should raw meat go on the counter?
Where should I keep the chicken?

facts: Always wash hands with soap and running water.
Use separate cutting boards for raw meat and vegetables.
Keep raw meat stored below cooked food in the fridge.
Always ask an adult to help with knives and heat.

quiz.say: When cutting vegetables, where is the safest place to work?

options.show: On a stable, clean cutting board.
options.say: On a stable, clean cutting board.

quiz.why: The cutting board provides a solid, designated surface for your knife.

wrong.0: It is too unstable and you might drop the food.
wrong.1: The plate is not designed for cutting and can break.
wrong.2: This is unsafe and you could trip over it.

quiz.say: What is the best way to prevent germs from raw meat?

options.show: Using separate cutting boards for raw meat.
options.say: Using separate cutting boards for raw meat.

quiz.why: This stops germs from raw meat from getting onto fresh food.

wrong.0: A quick wash does not use enough soap or time.
wrong.1: It is better to wash it by hand with soap first.
wrong.3: Wiping only removes visible dirt, not all the germs.

quiz.say: If you cut raw chicken and then cut salad on the same board, what is the biggest risk?
quiz.why: The bacteria from the raw chicken can move to the salad.

wrong.0: This is true, but the food is more at risk than the knife.
wrong.2: While it might taste different, the main danger is germs.
wrong.3: Messiness is a problem, but germs are a health risk.
